0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The enthusiastic observer needs help retrieving lost plants.

25.original: Deliver the tufts of cloud mallow to the enthusiastic observer.

48.original: What a sight! An ampelos sneezed and sent tufts of cloud mallow flying every which way.

49.original: But while highly amusing, I'll never be able to gather them all up alone...unless you're willing to lend a hand?

50.original: Thank you so much! Let's split up and start looking for them.

51.original: Be on the lookout for fluffy white plants floating around Poieten Oikos, and bring any you find back here.

52.original: Did you find any of the plants?

53.original: Perfect! It's such a relief to have them back...

54.original: A somewhat amateur creator invented the concept to bring more life into the clouds. Which is all well and good, but they get blown away far too easily.

55.original: It would be nice if they were a bit more wind resistant... We need to know they can settle in a place without fear of them flying off because some beast breathed on them too hard.

56.original: Well, I'd better put them back where they belong before a light breeze undoes all your hard work. Here, take this as thanks for your help.
